acceptance.given: Aggregate input contains the six required Matrix Case records and at least one required case execution is absent.

oracle.expected: After aggregate evaluation, status is failure and identifies the missing Matrix Case execution.
forbidden: Aggregate status is valid or passing while any required Matrix Case execution is absent.
oracle.observable: The aggregate result status and its missing-case diagnostics are inspected during runtime evaluation.

acceptance.then: The aggregate is marked failed and cannot be treated as a successful six-case evaluation.
acceptance.when: Run the aggregate evaluator with one or more required Matrix Case execution records removed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the aggregate evaluator against a fixture omitting one required Matrix Case execution and observe the aggregate failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Aggregate evaluation must report failure whenever any of the six required Matrix Case executions is missing; the runtime check must inspect the aggregate status and missing-case diagnostics.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing aggregate result categories and reject only incomplete Matrix Case coverage.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The aggregate result is terminal failure and names every required Matrix Case execution that is absent.

acceptance.given: Aggregate input references Matrix evidence that is reused by more than one required execution.

oracle.expected: The aggregate status is invalidated with a reused-evidence diagnostic during governance validation.
forbidden: The aggregate is treated as valid using reused Matrix evidence.
oracle.observable: The governance validator's aggregate status and evidence-identity diagnostics are inspected.

acceptance.then: The aggregate is invalidated and cannot advance as a valid evaluation.
acceptance.when: Run governance validation on an aggregate whose Matrix Case records intentionally point to the same evidence identity.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run aggregate governance validation with duplicated Matrix evidence identities and verify invalidation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Governance validation must detect reused Matrix evidence identities and invalidate the aggregate before any success decision.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain aggregate result schema while adding deterministic reused-evidence invalidation.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation emits an invalid aggregate status with a diagnostic identifying reused evidence and no success authorization.

acceptance.given: A replay package contains the original result-determining identities, pinned inputs, and terminal semantic verdict.

oracle.expected: In a fresh checkout, reconstruction first verifies the original binding identity, then replay with that same identity reproduces the terminal semantic verdict and Exact Cover.
forbidden: A changed binding identity is accepted for replay.
Fresh replay claims success with unpinned, changed, or unbound result-determining inputs.
The reconstructed terminal semantic verdict differs from the pinned original.
oracle.observable: The replay receipt records original-binding reconstruction, same-identity replay, identity comparison, terminal verdict, and Exact Cover equality.

acceptance.then: The fresh replay is accepted only when the rebuilt binding identity matches and the terminal semantic verdict and Exact Cover equal the original; otherwise it is stale or invalid.
acceptance.when: From a fresh checkout, rebuild all pinned result-determining identities, reject any mismatch, and replay using the reconstructed original binding identity.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run fresh-checkout replay with a changed result-determining input or mismatched binding and observe deterministic stale/invalid failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reconstruction must restore the original binding identity before replay, replay with that same identity, and reject identity mismatch or terminal semantic verdict/Exact Cover drift.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve terminal verdict categories and mark changed bound inputs stale rather than reinterpret them as success.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Replay receipt proves original binding reconstruction and same-identity replay; terminal verdict and Exact Cover match, or a mismatch yields stale/invalid terminal status.

acceptance.given: The requested target package is outside the supported Toolchain Skill package set.

oracle.expected: Target processing is rejected or halted with a deterministic unsupported-target failure before inspection is accepted.
forbidden: Processing proceeds with the unsupported target.
An unsupported target is accepted for inspection.
oracle.observable: The target-validation result and terminal status are inspected for fail-closed rejection.

acceptance.then: The unsupported target remains unaccepted and processing terminates unsuccessfully.
acceptance.when: Invoke target validation with an unsupported package target.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute target validation against an unsupported package target and verify rejection before effective inspection is accepted.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Target validation must fail closed for unsupported package identities and must not accept inspection results from outside the supported Toolchain Skill package set.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve supported VDD and Acceptance routes while rejecting unsupported targets before acceptance.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Target validation returns a deterministic unsuccessful terminal status and no accepted inspection receipt for the unsupported target.
